# URL structure inspector

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/url-inspector/

Inspect URL components, hostname encoding and visible structural warning signs. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Compare a URL’s actual hostname with its path, query parameters, port and any embedded username.

## Limits and checks

This is structural inspection only, not a live reputation lookup, phishing verdict or malware scanner. It does not open the submitted URL.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
